summary: Re-run after the F1 remediation (PM option B, commit 119a8de3): the allow-list pin adv 7 now passes on the real tree (49 entries, 43 files with hidden findings, all recorded exactly), and the earlier attacks adv 1 to 6 still hold at this HEAD (7 passed before the new cases). The five briefed attacks on the new guard were seeded in temp folders under apps/ with paired controls, committed as the passing adv 8: (a) a new carrier file fails the pin under each spelling (eslint and oxlint, whole-file block, next-line, trailing disable-line, and the JSX-wrapped block form) and the paired control entries pass clean; (b) a stale entry fails in both forms (the file lost the directive, the file is gone); (c) blanket growth fails through the kinds clause and through the blanket-block clause alone (blocks 2 vs recorded 0, with a passing control at 2); (d) a listed file whose next-line directive hides a different rule fails the live sweep (the stripped copy surfaces eslint(no-unused-vars), which an entry that records typescript(no-explicit-any) or an empty rule list does not cover); (e) a glob path entry and an empty rule list both fail, and a hiddenRules superset that would pass the unrecorded predicate silently is now caught by a new exactness assertion inside adv 7 (widenedAllowlistRules), verified exact on the real tree: a node replica of the sweep over all 49 carriers reported 0 extras and 0 missing, unlisted empty, stale empty. One new defect was found and committed as the failing guard adv 9: oxlint honors a mid-line block disable (code before the comment on the same line) and a block disable that spans lines, but the pin counts neither form (WHOLE_LINE_DISABLE_RE at scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:901 requires the comment to close its line; the trailing branch at :996 matches only // forms) and the sweep strips neither (stripDisableComments at :907), so a listed carrier file can hide a new live finding without failing adv 7; the real tree holds neither form today (the only non-whole-line directive is the trailing // eslint-disable-line at apps/bus-math-v2/hooks/usePhaseCompletion.ts:148), so the hole is latent. The full scripts suite shows 56 passed, 2 failed: adv 9 and the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row; the PROJECT_TESTS gate (test s2, GATES_RESUME=1, GATES_BASE=baseline-m2, after dropping the stale scripts-suite record) reports one new diagnostic, adv 9, NEWFAIL=1, exit 1, with the 27 workspace records and the audit-suites step compared clean.
blocking_findings: F1r2 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the adv 7 allow-list pin (F1 option B) misses two directive forms, so a listed carrier file can hide a new live oxlint finding without failing the guard. oxlint honors a mid-line block comment (for example `const keep = 1; /* eslint-disable */`) and a block comment that spans lines: live probes under apps/integrated-math-3 exit 0 with each form while the paired bare controls exit 1 with eslint(no-unused-vars). But `directiveKindsOfFile` counts neither form (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:981-1004: the whole-line regex at :901 requires the comment to close its own line, and the trailing branch at :996 matches only `//` forms), and `stripDisableComments` strips neither form (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:907-913), so the kinds, directive-count, and blanket-block pins stay unchanged and the sweep never surfaces the newly hidden rule. The guard comment claims 'a new blanket block ... fail adv 7' (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:958), which is false for these two blanket forms. The real tree holds neither form today (rg over the source files of apps/ and packages/: the only non-whole-line directive is the trailing `// eslint-disable-line` at apps/bus-math-v2/hooks/usePhaseCompletion.ts:148), so the hole is latent, not live. This also keeps open the strategy section 8 risk 'Zero warnings by blanket disable' (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/test-strategy.md:539). The committed failing guard is 'S2 adversarial > adv 9' (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1621). Green must extend the directive counting and the strip to mid-line and multi-line block comments in both spellings, so the pin and the sweep see them.
nonblocking_findings: F2r2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: the allow-list fixture itself can be widened without an independent anchor. An entry whose directiveCount or blanketBlocks is raised inside scripts/__tests__/fixtures/lint-disable-allowlist.json passes the pin, because the pin compares each file only against the fixture. The other widening paths now fail: a glob path leaves the carrier unlisted, an empty hiddenRules list fails the sweep, and a hiddenRules superset fails the new exactness assertion in adv 7 (the real fixture is exact: 49 entries, 0 extras, 0 missing). Default disposition: accept; the review of the fixture diff is the defense for count inflation. Per the Hashing and Scope Policy of AGENTS.md, no hash anchor is added.

adv 8 attack d, live sweep: the seeded carrier exits 0, the stripped copy exits 1 with eslint(no-unused-vars); an entry that records typescript(no-explicit-any) does not cover it, an empty rule list does not cover it, the exact rule covers it

adv 7 exactness on the real tree passes: a node replica of the sweep (49 carriers, stripped copies linted with the root config) reported surfaced files 43, EXTRAS 0, MISSING 0, unlisted [], stale []; the in-test assertion widenedAllowlistRules(allowlist, surfacedByReal) returned []

the real tree holds no mid-line or multi-line disable: rg over the source files of apps/ and packages/ finds one non-whole-line directive, the trailing // eslint-disable-line at apps/bus-math-v2/hooks/usePhaseCompletion.ts:148

ratings.evidence: The pin now does what option B requires on unlisted carriers, stale entries, blanket growth, changed directives, and widened entries (adv 8 passes with controls), but the adv 9 guard fails: two blanket disable forms evade both the pin and the sweep (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1621).

Each pin clause has a seeded failing-side proof with a paired control (adv 8, scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1426), and the hiddenRules superset hole is closed by the exactness assertion in adv 7, but the suppression-coverage claim itself fails until Green strengthens the strip (adv 9).
